# 1 Clement Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 3 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 3

**3:1** All glory and enlargement was given to you, and that which was written was fulfilled: "My beloved ate and drank and was enlarged and grew fat and kicked." [Deut 32:15]

**3:2** From this arose jealousy and envy, strife and sedition, persecution and disorder, war and captivity.

**3:3** So the dishonorable rose up against the honorable, the inglorious against the glorious, the foolish against the prudent, the young against the older.

**3:4** Because of this righteousness and peace have been driven far away, since each man has abandoned the fear of God and become dim-sighted in the faith, neither walking in the ordinances of his commandments nor conducting himself as befits Christ, but each walking according to the desires of his evil heart, having taken up unrighteous and impious jealousy, through which also death entered the world.

---

*EMET: "enlarged and grew fat and kicked" preserves the LXX verbatim. The Deuteronomy quotation is the pivot of the entire argument.*
